zero_means: never: every open-list merge-state read of the conductor goes to GitHub, as before BH-8457
note: BH-8457. The merge conductor (HPL_PR_RECORD=1) answers each open-list row's merge-state read (the GitHub pulls/{n} GET) from the PR record (pr_record_peek, one jobs GET, no GitHub call) when the record is open, at the list head, has a known mergeable_state, and is at most this many seconds old (the worker's now minus the record's last write). A miss reads GitHub and writes the answer back into the record. A PR whose CI goes green is seen at most this long after the record's last write; the enqueue decision still reads the PR live. Read through lane_knob (libs scope) when the caller has it, else from the environment; a value that is not a non-negative integer is 120 and one logs/pr-record.log line names it.
